Class Gastropoda > sea slugs > Order Sacoglossa > Elysia species Elysia slugs on Singapore shores awaiting identification
back to general info on elysia slugs

Unidentified Elysia slug #1
About 2cm long. Green body with only has a black margin around the parapodia (no orange margin). Little black spots. Pulau Sekudu, May 04

Unidentified Elysia slug #2
About 0.5-1cm long. Olive green body tapering ‘wings’ and very long rhinophores. Many seen on a bloom of unknown fine hairy green stuff on a sandy silty shore. Seletar Feb 12


White knobs possibly the penis?
